sources.summary: For Second Hand September, tell us about your favourite preloved clothes and accessories Oxfam’s Second Hand September campaign encourages people to avoid buying new clothes for 30 days and choose secondhand instead, in an effort to reduce the waste and carbon emissions associated with the fashion industry. Are you a devoted secondhand shopper? Perhaps you’ve found a designer piece for a fraction of the original price, discovered the perfect vintage coat or dress, or picked up something you’ve worn for years. Continue reading...
